notes.title: Update 0.1.2 Is Live!
notes.content:
[h1]Patch 0.1.2 Notes[/h1]

[h3][b]Hello![/b][/h3]

This is our first patch of the year, introducing some major changes to the way the "Red District" level plays out as well as some general and quality-of-life changes. Some of these changes may require some future work, and as per usual we welcome any and all feedback! 

You can find the exact list of changes below:

[h3][b]General Changes[/b][/h3]
[list]
[*] Changed the UI to allow for previously unaccounted for resolutions and aspect ratios (do let us know if you run into issues with this!)
[*] Performance improvements across the board, primarily in "Red District"
[*] Added new sprites for enemies shooting blue projectiles
[*] Added checkpoint functionality, currently only in the "Red District" level
[*] Added a "Retry" button to the death screen, visible when a checkpoint is active
[*] Changed lighting rendering type
[/list]

[h3][b]Gameplay Changes[/b][/h3]
[list]
[*] Slightly increased Berserk attack range
[*] Changed Berserk heal to feel smoother
[*] Changed powerup behavior to disappear when picked up (some may respawn after a delay)
[/list]

[h3][b]Level-Specific Changes[/b][/h3]
[h3]Training:[/h3]
[list]
[*] Doubled boss door opening speed
[*] Changed sprites for blue projectile enemies
[/list]

[h3]Red District:[/h3]
[list]
[*] Major overhaul to level progression
[*] Added new level geometry to several locations
[*] Changed existing level geometry in a few locations
[*] Adjusted requirements for progression to accomodate changes
[*] Adjusted rank requirements to match the new design
[*] Added new guiding elements to better highlight boss location once unlocked
[*] Fixed a hole in level geometry allowing out-of-bounds access above the hangar
[*] Added disco lights to a private party
[/list]

[h3]Red District - Boss:[/h3]
[list]
[*] Added a checkpoint to the hallway before the encounter
[*] Doubled the boss door opening and closing speed
[*] The boss can now be damaged with parried projectiles
[*] Added new lights to better signpost the mechanics of the encounter
[*] Added health pickups to the boss arena to give players a second wind
[*] Added a new sound effect to indicate invulnerability
[/list]

A quick note regarding the checkpoint system: the game currently does not track player deaths in any way, nor are checkpoint restarts penalized in any way, although the damage taken during attempts will still be calculated as a rank penalty. This will change in the future, but for the time being, feel free to enjoy the penalty-free checkpoint restarts!

[h3]Nightmare:[/h3]
[list]
[*] Changed big enemies to better indicate that they are indestructible
[/list]

notes.title: Development Update
notes.content:
[h1]Hello fellow fingerbangers![/h1]

After a lengthy Christmas break we are right back at it with development and there are some major updates in store for the future, so hopefully you've cracked your knuckles and flexed your fingers in preparation for things to come!

[h2]The Immediate Future[/h2]

Our development roadmap consists of building additional content for the game throughout the spring of 2023, with a major focus being on our most requested addition: new levels. However, with the pressure of a December release date behind us, we have also taken another look at the levels currently in the game, and have had the time to work out some of the changes we wanted to implement originally but lacked either the time or resources to implement before initial release.

With this being the case, our first update to the game will also introduce some small background changes:

A demo version of the game will appear on the store page, this is due to us having to preserve a version of the game as it was on release (for bureaucratic reasons with our publisher). This demo version will not be updated or changed in any way going forward.

The current version of the game will continue to receive updates and new content as soon as we manage to create and test them. This can and will include fundamental changes to how the game plays, creating a larger gap between the demo version and the current version.

We would also like to note that the game will still remain free for anyone to download and play, the introduction of a demo version should not affect our players in any way. If anything, the demo version serves as a piece of history and reminder of where we started from as the game evolves with further development.

[h2]First Update To Content[/h2]

As we have also had the time to go over some of the content produced by our players and have received plenty of feedback about the current version of the game, our first update will introduce a rework to the way the "Red District" level plays out! We finally have a long-awaited checkpoint available before the boss fight and there have been some changes to the progression throughout the level in order to make it play out more logically. In addition to this we have various small improvements to the boss fight itself. We have also kept some more obscure routes available for any speed demons out there who want to try breaking any existing records on completion time as well.

Additionally, this update also brings with it some minor changes such as the introduction of ultrawide resolution support, some of which might require further tuning in coming updates. The update is expected to roll out sometime this week, by the 17th of February at the latest. As usual, we welcome all feedback regarding the game and please look forward to more details about specific changes in the upcoming patch notes!

[h2]Later Down The Line[/h2]

While this initial update only changes existing levels, we are also keeping ourselves busy with the development of new levels, and have several in the works already. On top of this, players can look forward to the addition of both Steam leaderboards as well as achievements in the future. We can't make any promises as to when either the new levels or these new features will be made available to play yet, but we wanted to let our players know that we are indeed working on new content and features!

notes.title: First Post-Release Patch (v0.1.1)
notes.content:
[h1]Patch 0.1.1 Notes[/h1]

[h3][b]Hello![/b][/h3]

This is our first post-release patch, introducing some slight quality-of-life changes as well as more comprehensive changes to enemy behavior and values. The update size is rather large due to changes taking place across multiple levels. You can find the exact changes listed below:

[h3][b]Quality-Of-Life Changes[/b][/h3]
[list]
[*] Mouse sensitivity now goes down all the way to 0.1 instead of 1
[*] You can now set vertical mouse movement to inverted in the options menu
[/list]

[h3][b]General Changes[/b][/h3]
[list]
[*] Pulled the enemy gun position a bit closer to the body
[*] Potential fix for enemies being able to shoot after dying
[/list]

[h3][b]Level-Specific Changes[/b][/h3]
[h3]Training Level:[/h3]
[list]
[*] Potential fix for boss getting stuck on the door.
[*] Moved green room enemies a bit closer to the door
[*] Adjusted the position of blue room enemies to further apart from one another
[*] Increased blue room enemy aggro range
[/list]

[h3]Red District:[/h3]
[list]
[*] Increased roaming enemies vision range from 22 -> 30
[*] Increased roaming enemies aggro range from 15 -> 25
[/list]

[h3]Nightmare:[/h3]
[list]
[*] Increased enemy vision range from 20 -> 25
[*] Increased enemy aggro range from 20 -> 25
[*] Increased enemy shooting range from 20 -> 25
[/list]
